subject: english
stem: The following notice gives details for a planned activity. Which action is planned or required in the full message?
options: look for an independent test of the yellow bottle
compare two pages that repeat the yellow bottle claim
check only the store page for the yellow bottle
share the yellow bottle claim after reading its first source
